title: wg: virtual-clients-01 L517 No function maps signature_key_secret to a signature key pair, and the...
description:
draft-ietf-mls-virtual-clients (virtual-clients-01), Generating Virtual Client Secrets. Editors' copy mlswg/mls-virtual-clients at 65e960d, L517.

Text: "An application MAY use `signature_key_secret` with the target ciphersuite's
signature algorithm to derive a fresh signing key per operation,"

Problem: No function maps signature_key_secret to a signature key pair, and the right construction differs by scheme (Ed25519, ECDSA, ML-DSA). Emulator clients cannot derive the same key unless the application specifies the mapping, and the text does not say that it must. L1366-1367 and L1397-1399 depend on the same derivation.

Suggested fix: Define a per-scheme DeriveSignatureKeyPair, or state that the application MUST specify the mapping when it uses this option.

Severity: low. Verifier: narrow (Confirmed: RFC 9420 defines no secret-to-signature-key derivation. L516 makes the signing-key source application-defined, though, so the impact is limited to the MAY option: unless the application also defines the mapping, the option is not interoperable. Severity is lowered.)

From MLS audit workflow wf_581e61f8-b25 (2026-10-21). Not yet reviewed by Mark; nothing posted upstream.
